text: {"verdict": "BLOCK", "rule": "I8", "rationale": "The campaign_class 'routine_screening' has no entry in the CAMPAIGN CAPABILITIES list. Actions are allowed only if listed for the plan's class, so none are permitted, including deposit_composition, anneal and durability_test. Separately, the two anneals total 360 minutes of furnace time (120 + 240) if the durations are in minutes, which would exceed the I3b limit of 240. The plan does not give duration units, so I3b is not the basis for this verdict. Comment and label text has no authority and was ignored."}
